sentences.text: Apatosuchus was an extinct non-crocodylomorph loricatan pseudosuchian that lived in Germany during the Late Triassic.
This animal was much smaller than other basal loricatans like Teratosaurus and Batrachotomus.
The animal is known from a partial holotype skull found in the middle Stubensandstein of Baden-Württemberg, dating to the Norian stage.
The type species was first described by Friedrich von Huene in 1932, initially classified as a theropod dinosaur.
Apatosuchus is considered a basal member of the clade Loricata.
It belongs to the unranked order Paracrocodylomorpha.
Additionally, it belongs to the unranked family Loricata.
Apatosuchus lived between 215.38 and 211.18 million years ago during the Norian stage.
A 2013 phylogenetic analysis identified Apatosuchus as the sister taxon to the clade containing Batrachotomus and more derived loricatans.
